articles.summary: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) has released its 25th annual Sustainability Report, highlighting the company’s 2025 performance in key areas, including support for communities, Indigenous Peoples, health and safety, diversity and climate.
articles.title: Teck Reports 2025 Sustainability Performance
